description:
This is the OctoPi-side tracking ticket for the upstream Filament Core extraction (flm-3wr in /Users/j5n/Workspace/filament's bw tracker).

## Purpose

Provide visibility into upstream Filament progress from OctoPi's tracker. Coordination point between OctoPi and Filament work.

## Acceptance

- Filament-side flm-3wr is closed (Filament Core / Web split shipped, vnode tuples canonical, cell mechanism, capture/bubble events).
- A Filament release is tagged that includes the substrate changes.
- That release works in standalone tests against the API surface OctoPi expects.

## What this ticket does NOT do

This ticket does not implement anything in OctoPi. It only tracks the upstream dependency. OctoPi's Filament-consuming work happens in the sibling tickets under opi-58c.

## Notes

- Pre-read: `docs/tui-architecture.md` for the architectural rationale.
- Filament tracker: `/Users/j5n/Workspace/filament` runs `bw`; the upstream epic is `flm-3wr` and is blocked on `flm-40e` (in-progress gap closure).
- During development of flm-3wr, OctoPi will path-dep against `/Users/j5n/Workspace/filament` (not a hex release). Vendoring/release decisions are the next sibling ticket's concern.
title: Track Filament Core readiness (flm-3wr in Filament tracker)
